nodes.label: Published item availability audit
nodes.rationale: Ten items and all 129 published Unit 1 questions were audited through the real API and temporary PostgreSQL users; fixtures are deleted afterward.

nodes.label: Essential verification preserves checkpoint practice
nodes.rationale: The old point-number guard blocked all twenty questions of points 5 and 10. The final graded entries 5-12 and 10-12 remain protected; eighteen practice questions lose the inappropriate restriction. Explicit essential metadata is read from the original entry even after replacement.

nodes.label: Skip and defer refresh the confirmed destination
nodes.rationale: Advancing items close the bag and navigate to the server-confirmed destination before applying or reloading the old model. Router refresh prevents a persisted skip from leaving the old question visible.

nodes.label: Measured compatibility across 129 questions
nodes.rationale: Independent first-round contexts with positive stock and no prior answer, skip or help: pass 127, hint 129, lens 106, example 11, swap 11, defer 119. These counts are not per-session usage limits; at least half the graded questions must be answered.

nodes.label: Reviewed example and swap coverage
nodes.rationale: Each point has at least one compatible example/swap context, covering eleven questions overall. Missing reviewed content remains unavailable without charging; generic help from another skill is not substituted.

nodes.label: Shield and cosmetic inventory criteria
nodes.rationale: Shield requires valid streak, stock and no armed protection, without reviving an ended streak. Three cosmetics are permanent equipment. The companion follower is hidden on small screens while ownership/equipment remains recorded.

nodes.label: Item audit regression verification
nodes.rationale: Seventeen unit tests, production build and typecheck passed. Real API tests cover all published questions, economy and progression. Chrome tests verify skip/swap on checkpoint practice, essential-question blocking, next-question navigation, shop and bag on desktop/mobile. Auto-submit requires opening the bag before selecting an answer.
